_readme: Recurring rules the site's patch.json doesn't already have. Daily reset, weekly reset and Guild War come from patch.json (resets, guildWar), so they are NOT repeated here. A rule is either {"sameAs": "daily"|"weekly"} (follows the site's reset) or {"weekday": 0-6 (0=Sun) or null for daily, "time": "HH:MM", "utcOffset": 8}. Every rule needs a source. See README > How to update.

rules.label: Battle Pass weekly EXP cap
rules.source: Site patch.json resets.note: 'The Battle Pass weekly EXP cap also resets Monday 05:00 UTC+8' (and checklist bp-cap note).
